description: This file provides a singleton object RepositoryProvider, which acts as a factory for creating and providing various repository instances (ProfileRepository, ConnectionRepository, TransferHistoryRepository). These repositories are backed by a Room database, leveraging Data Access Object (DAO) interfaces from AppDatabase to instantiate each repository, facilitating data management and abstraction within the application.

classes.name: RepositoryProvider
classes.description: Singleton object serving as a factory/provider for repository instances that interact with the Room database.

methods.name: profileRepository
methods.description: Creates and returns a ProfileRepository instance using the ProfileDao from the Room database.

methods.name: connectionRepository
methods.description: Creates and returns a ConnectionRepository instance using the ConnectionDao from the Room database.

methods.name: transferHistoryRepository
methods.description: Creates and returns a TransferHistoryRepository instance using the TransferHistoryDao from the Room database.
